usedFor: Outreach results in Woodpecker, like “Prospect Interested”, hand the prospect a booking link from Calendly.

bestTemplate.name: “Prospect Interested” in Woodpecker, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A prospect marked interested gets a booking link for the next call from the action.

watchOut: “Prospect Blacklisted done” also fires when someone unsubscribes, so keep it away from “Create Scheduling Link”.
